requirements.title: Allocated status of allocatable variables and its consequences
requirements.definition: An allocatable entity has allocation status. The status of an allocatable variable becomes allocated when it is allocated by ALLOCATE, allocated during assignment, or given that status by MOVE_ALLOC. An allocated allocatable variable may be referenced, defined, or deallocated; allocating it causes an ALLOCATE error condition; and ALLOCATED returns true for it.

pending.allocated-by-allocate: PENDING complete source allocating an INTEGER allocatable scalar or array with STAT=, then observing ALLOCATED=.TRUE., STAT=0, and a literal value assigned after allocation. The oracle distinguishes allocation status from declaration by checking ALLOCATED before and after.
pending.allocated-by-assignment: PENDING complete source with an unallocated allocatable left side assigned a rank-compatible literal array, then observing ALLOCATED=.TRUE., SHAPE matching the expression, and copied literals. Intrinsic assignment details remain 10.2.1.3 dependencies.
pending.allocated-by-move-alloc: PENDING complete source with FROM allocated and TO unallocated before MOVE_ALLOC, observing TO ALLOCATED=.TRUE., FROM ALLOCATED=.FALSE., and TO literal contents. The oracle is the status pair and literal value under MOVE_ALLOC ownership.
pending.allocated-reference-define-deallocate: PENDING complete source allocating an allocatable array, assigning element literals, referencing them in a sum, then DEALLOCATE with STAT=0. The non-vacuous oracle is the literal sum and final ALLOCATED=.FALSE. via 9.7.3 ownership.
pending.allocating-allocated-variable-error: PENDING runtime diagnostic/control source: allocate an allocatable variable, then execute a second ALLOCATE for it with STAT= present and observe a standard error indication from 9.7.4. The repaired control deallocates first and reaches STAT=0; this is not resource-exhaustion allocation failure.
pending.allocated-inquiry-true: PENDING complete source observing ALLOCATED returns false before ALLOCATE and true after successful ALLOCATE for the same variable, with a literal assignment proving the allocated path executed.

requirements.title: Unallocated status of allocatable variables and its consequences
requirements.definition: An allocatable variable is unallocated if it is not allocated. It becomes unallocated when deallocated or given that status by MOVE_ALLOC. An unallocated allocatable variable shall not be referenced or defined and shall not be supplied as an actual argument to a nonallocatable nonoptional dummy argument except to certain intrinsic inquiry functions. It may be allocated by ALLOCATE. Deallocating it causes a DEALLOCATE error condition, and ALLOCATED returns false for it.

pending.unallocated-by-deallocate: PENDING complete source allocating then deallocating an allocatable variable with STAT=0, observing ALLOCATED changes from true to false. The plan does not reference the variable value after deallocation.
pending.unallocated-by-move-alloc-from: PENDING complete source using MOVE_ALLOC so the FROM variable becomes unallocated and TO becomes allocated, observing the ALLOCATED status pair and a literal value through TO only.
pending.unallocated-reference-or-define-invalid: PENDING diagnostic/control source attempting to reference or define an unallocated allocatable variable in an otherwise valid program, repaired by adding only a prior ALLOCATE and literal definition. The invalidity is attributable to S9.7.1.3-002, not to declaration or designator syntax, and the invalid source is not executed to read unallocated storage.
pending.unallocated-actual-argument-invalid: PENDING diagnostic/control source passing an unallocated allocatable actual to a nonallocatable nonoptional dummy that would otherwise accept its type, kind, and rank, repaired by allocating and defining the actual first. The repaired oracle is a dummy-observed literal; attribution excludes explicit-interface or rank mismatch rules.
pending.unallocated-may-be-allocated: PENDING complete source proving ALLOCATED=.FALSE. immediately before ALLOCATE, then STAT=0, ALLOCATED=.TRUE., and a literal assignment after allocation.
pending.unallocated-inquiry-false-and-deallocate: PENDING source plan observing ALLOCATED returns false for an unallocated variable, and separately using DEALLOCATE with STAT= on an unallocated variable to observe a 9.7.3/9.7.4 error indication. No unallocated value or bounds are read.

requirements.title: Allocatable variables begin program execution unallocated
requirements.definition: At the beginning of execution of a program, allocatable variables are unallocated.

pending.program-start-unallocated: PENDING complete source with a module or main-program allocatable variable and an immediate ALLOCATED inquiry before any ALLOCATE, assignment allocation, MOVE_ALLOC, or argument association. The oracle is ALLOCATED=.FALSE. plus a reached literal sentinel; no value, bounds, or storage of the unallocated variable is read.

requirements.title: Associated allocatable variables share allocation-status changes and deferred parameter values
requirements.definition: When the allocation status of an allocatable variable changes, the allocation status of any associated allocatable variable changes accordingly. Allocation of an allocatable variable establishes values for deferred type parameters of all associated allocatable variables.

pending.associated-status-changes: PENDING complete source with an allocatable dummy or associate name associated with an allocatable actual under the owning association rules, changing allocation status through one entity and observing ALLOCATED status through the other without reading an unallocated value. The oracle is the status pair before and after.
pending.associated-deferred-type-parameters-esta: PENDING complete source with an associated allocatable character or parameterized derived-type entity having a deferred length parameter, allocating through one name and observing the established LEN or type-parameter inquiry through the associated name plus STAT=0.

requirements.title: Unsaved allocatable local variables begin each invocation or construct execution unallocated
requirements.definition: An unsaved allocatable local variable of a procedure is unallocated at the beginning of each invocation of the procedure, and an unsaved allocatable local variable of a construct is unallocated at the beginning of each execution of the construct.

pending.procedure-local-each-invocation: PENDING complete source calling a procedure twice where an unsaved local allocatable is allocated only during the first call and queried at entry on each call. The oracle is entry ALLOCATED=.FALSE. for both invocations plus distinct call-number literals.
pending.construct-local-each-execution: PENDING complete source executing a BLOCK construct twice with an unsaved local allocatable declared inside and queried before any allocation in each execution. The oracle is ALLOCATED=.FALSE. and iteration sentinels; no SAVE attribute or host variable is used.

requirements.title: Allocated derived objects initialize allocatable ultimate components according to SOURCE=
requirements.definition: When an object of derived type is created by an ALLOCATE statement, its allocatable ultimate components have allocation status unallocated unless SOURCE= appears and the corresponding component of source-expr is allocated.

pending.allocatable-components-unallocated-witho: PENDING complete source allocating an object of derived type with an allocatable ultimate component and no SOURCE=, then observing ALLOCATED(component)=.FALSE. and a separate default-initialized nonallocatable component literal if present. The component value is not referenced while unallocated.
pending.source-allocated-component-copied-status: PENDING complete source with a derived-type SOURCE= object whose corresponding allocatable component is allocated and defined with literal values, allocating a new object and observing the destination component ALLOCATED=.TRUE., matching shape, and copied literals. Definition-status details remain 19.6.5(20) dependencies.
pending.source-unallocated-component-remains-una: PENDING complete source with SOURCE= where the corresponding allocatable component is unallocated, observing the destination component ALLOCATED=.FALSE. and a separate scalar sentinel copied from a defined nonallocatable component. No unallocated component payload is read.

requirements.title: Function side effects on allocation status may be processor dependent when the value is not needed
requirements.definition: If evaluating a function would change the allocation status of a variable, and a reference to the function appears in an expression where the function value is not needed to determine the expression value, the variable allocation status after expression evaluation is processor dependent.

pending.short-circuit-allocation-side-effect-bou: PENDING source-only plan with a function that would allocate or deallocate a tracked allocatable variable and returns a logical value in an expression whose result can be determined without that function value. The oracle is classification only: future executable tests must not require either final allocation status as portable.
pending.processor-dependent-result-recorded: PENDING paired controls where the same function is used in a context that definitely needs its value, observing the portable status change and a literal return value, contrasted with the p6 expression recorded as processor-dependent. The catalogue must not mark either outcome of the p6 expression as pass/fail coverage.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_094.json reads all six original 9.7.1.3 units and their25 fine units in full and confirms the allocation semantics for allocatable variables, including the resulting allocation status, the bounds and length parameters established by the allocation, the deferred type parameter values and the conditions under which an allocatable variable shall not be allocated. Allocation and definition status semantics remain owned by 19.5.x and 19.6.x and the ALLOCATABLE attribute by 8.5.3. All22 facets remain pending source plans; no case, execution, oracle or fixture approval is created.
